name: sprint-recap
description: Turn a finished sprint into a narrated walkthrough video of the real app plus a matching HTML reproduction guide. Correlates Azure DevOps iteration items, git history and Claude session transcripts into a reviewable step script, captures one browser clip per step under read-only discipline, renders it with Remotion step-text overlays, and publishes a shareable guide whose credentials stay in a separate gitignored file.

include_session_prompts.title: Copy prompt text from Claude sessions
include_session_prompts.description: When true, the collect stage copies up to 12 prompts per matching session into evidence.json, with secrets and e-mail addresses masked. When false (default), sessions contribute only ids, dates, branches and work-item IDs.

tts_voice.title: Narration voice
tts_voice.description: edge-tts voice used by render --narrate, e.g. en-US-AriaNeural or ar-EG-SalmaNeural. Narration text is sent to Microsoft's online read-aloud service.
